title: Make 5 / Benchmark Mastery Check
objective: Determine whether complements to 10 are secure enough to begin Unit 1.3's Make 10 strategy. This is the single most important gate in Foundation Release 1.

tasks.prompt: State the complement to 10 for at least 6 of 8 given numbers 1-9, from memory.
Given a number, correctly state whether it's closer to 5 or to 10, with a distance justification.

mastery.passEvidence: Both tasks correct at the stated thresholds.
mastery.reteachTrigger: Cannot state complements to 10 without rebuilding a ten-frame for most numbers — reteach 1.2.3-1.2.4 before proceeding to Unit 1.3.
